scheme_name: Award Of Stipend To VJNT And SBC Students Studying In ITI
other_conditions: Students must be trainees of an approved I.T.I.
Selection is completed by the Principal of the concerned I.T.I.
Eligibility category noted in source: V.J.N.T.
Eligibility category noted in source: S.B.C.
benefits_summary: Eligible VJNT and SBC students studying in approved ITIs receive a monthly stipend of Rs.40‑Rs.100 for ten months.
